symptom_signature.description: Both HPCI trains A and B fail post-maintenance surveillance flow acceptance criterion (SURV-U3-HPCI-001). Both trains achieve injection but fail to reach required flow within required time. Failure mode identical on both: pump coupling slippage under load from incorrect torque application. Pump coupling assemblies replaced during outage using parts from vendor lot VEN-2026-Q1-HC7.

initial_assessment: Both HPCI trains fail surveillance flow acceptance criterion following coupling replacement. Identical failure mode on both trains — coupling slippage under load. Vendor lot VEN-2026-Q1-HC7 used for both assemblies. CCF evaluation required.
